review_boundaries: Fresh pinned Slither 0.11.6 analyzed a complete current 30-source normal-profile AST/input/output unit with bytecode-matched artifacts and unchanged source hashes; no compilation was invoked by Slither.

Of 221 prior entries, 213 retain identical detector semantics: 154 exact fingerprints and 59 differing only by source line ranges. Their historical dispositions were retained after reviewing the changed shared authorization and valuation call paths; this is not a fresh comprehensive audit of unchanged logic.

Sixteen new/changed findings were reviewed individually: five High join-accounting reports, nine Medium custody reentrancy reports, the helper Snapshot initialization report and the unchanged guard return with a changed unwind signature. Eight old call-graph entries are explicitly superseded; no finding is silently dropped.
An independent collaborating Codex agent separately reviewed the five new High reports and helper/preparation boundaries. This remains internal review, not an external independent audit.

The local budget caches fresh prices before callbacks, adds only exact designated compound, and enforces ceil(97%) retained principal with at most 5% attributed idle. Activation/top-up 99% marginal-deployed requirements and ordered-pair checks remain. Parking-before-resume, ordinary rebalance, asynchronous transport, different-pair conversion and canonical export/import are outside this guarantee.

Preparation is cancellable notice and a new-work/protocol-module-configuration barrier; claims/transfers/reveal and permitted inbound/funded-reward/drain work remain. It is not canonical freeze/export/import or successor authority. Inherited timelock role administration remains available; the protocol delay override remains fixed.
The fresh run first rejected incomplete incremental compiler AST evidence before analysis. A complete normal build repaired evidence only; the failed preflight is preserved separately.

The existing 43 matcher cases were run once in this workstream and passed; their code is unchanged. No further unchanged matcher rerun is used. Nine fresh rejection mutations are tied to the new helper finding and source binding.

Historical dynamic-test references retain their original receipts and scope; this static review does not assert they were rerun. See the current migration-safety verification for newly executed tests. No current-source fork or production gas qualification is inferred.

Admitted token/venue/oracle truth, donations coinciding with close return deltas, remote admission proofs and provider backing/finality remain trust/release risks. Source helper adds no arbitrary execution, recipient, upgrade or principal withdrawal.

Normal runtime limits are met with only 17 bytes free in Vault and 30 in Migration. Production services/routes/gas, authorities, real operating qualification, canonical transition implementation and independent audit remain open. Zero unresolved detector entries is not release approval.
